# Structa Global

> Structa Global curates and delivers certified façade systems, structural components, interior finishes and sustainable building materials for architects, contractors and developers in the USA, Canada, the UK and India. Founded in Kochi, Kerala, in 2004. Tagline: Engineered Trust. Delivered.

- Headquarters: KK Buildings, Thoundayil Road, Panampilly Nagar, Kochi, Kerala 682 036, India
- Phone: +91 99471 06111 · Email: hello@structaglobal.com · Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 18:00 IST
- Kerala service areas: Kochi (HQ, since 2004), Thiruvananthapuram and Thrissur (since 2010), Kozhikode and Kottayam (since 2020)
- Quality: ISO 9001:2015 quality management; CE, BIS and ASTM tested products; product data for IGBC, LEED and GRIHA credits
- Response time: within one business day

## Company

- [Structa Global | Certified Architectural Building Materials](https://www.structaglobal.com/): Certified façade systems, structural components and interior finishes, specified with architects in the USA, Canada, the UK and India. Headquartered in Kochi.
- [About Structa Global | The Architect's Ally](https://www.structaglobal.com/about/): Founded in Kochi in 2004, Structa Global curates certified façade, structural and finish materials and supports design teams from specification to installation.
- [Our Story | Structa Global, Since 2004](https://www.structaglobal.com/our-story/): From a single office in Kochi in 2004 to a four-market architectural materials partner: the milestones behind Structa Global.
- [Sustainability | IGBC, LEED and GRIHA Materials | Structa Global](https://www.structaglobal.com/sustainability/): Low-carbon, FSC-certified and EPD-documented building materials, with the product data your project needs for IGBC, LEED and GRIHA credits.
- [Certifications | ISO 9001, CE, BIS, ASTM | Structa Global](https://www.structaglobal.com/certifications/): ISO 9001:2015 quality management, CE, BIS and ASTM tested materials, and IGBC, LEED and GRIHA credit data, with a full documentation pack on every delivery.
- [Careers | Architectural Materials Jobs in Kerala | Structa Global](https://www.structaglobal.com/careers/): Open roles at Structa Global in Kochi and Trivandrum: technical sales, specification, supply chain, green building and digital marketing.
- [Contact Structa Global | Request a Specification](https://www.structaglobal.com/contact/): Request a specification, quotation or certificates. Our technical team replies within one business day. Kochi HQ, +91 99471 06111, hello@structaglobal.com.

- [Sourcing Architectural Materials in Kerala | Structa Global](https://www.structaglobal.com/blog/sourcing-materials-kerala/): A five-stage guide to sourcing certified building materials in Kerala: performance briefs, supplier checks, certificate verification and lead times.
